title: How To Disable Option To Complete Member's Address Based On The Map's Marker
text:
## How To Disable Option To Complete Member's Address Based On The Map's Marker
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000065750
Member's of the directory have the option to select and set their location based on the location of the marker in the map on the Contact Details form:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105280465/original/8zgz-XHKusHNo8S8p4znazF5Yj7PhceEfQ.png?1645316810 | alt: ]
Use the Advanced Setting:
Disable Drag-able Pins on Member Google Maps
System Variable: disable_drag_drop_member_map
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647200/original/lrT7wgLKomvvjJAQWaJS-UW19dEOcYPTGw.png?1753160999 | alt: ]
Once the Advanced Setting is enabled, the option to move the pin is gone:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105280508/original/OBGyAJoqFhBM1cNfnj71-sVzaGNWNNVQ-A.png?1645316984 | alt: ]
